today_summary: GCM26 sits $4,414.1 after a +$18.1 bounce off Wednesday's $4,396 low, the first up-session in four. Chain is structurally call-heavy (P/C OI 0.39, 204,249 calls vs 80,580 puts) but flow was even more one-sided intraday — P/C volume 0.24, the most call-skewed print of the week. Tradable structure is a $200 box: the $4,300 put shelf (4,052 contracts) beneath, the $4,500 call wall (11,093 contracts) above. ATM IV 22.73% implies a 1σ daily move of $63.20 (1.43%).
five_day_thesis: Five sessions have taken spot from $4,663.1 to $4,414.1 (−$249.0, −5.3%) with no defensive repositioning to match — the $3,500 put wall has not moved a single tick in five days and put OI added only 3,635 contracts against a $249 decline, so this is long liquidation, not put accumulation. The decisive structural break was the call wall collapsing $8,000 → $6,000 on 2026-09-02, and with it max pain sliding $6,000 → $5,690 (−$310); both are legacy deep-OTM inventory unwinding rather than a real magnet, and max pain sitting +$1,276 above spot should be discounted, not traded. Dealer posture stayed long gamma all five days, but the ±$200 window decayed from +854.8 to +441.4 by Wednesday before rebounding to +494.9 — the damping cushion has thinned by 42% while the gamma flip drifted $3,735 → $3,540, meaning the short-gamma trapdoor moved further away even as the buffer weakened. ATM IV compressed 24.55% → 22.73% (−1.82pp) straight through a 5% drawdown, an unusual sign that the selloff is being absorbed as orderly rather than panicked. Yesterday's +1,144 call OI build at $4,700 is the first genuinely new upside positioning of the week and marks where cumulative net GEX turns durably positive.

prediction: Bias neutral-to-constructive inside $4,300–$4,500 while local net GEX stays positive at +203.8 — dealers are still damping, which favors mean reversion over trend continuation and caps realized range near the $63 1σ. Path of least resistance is a retest of the $4,500 call wall, the single largest positive-gamma node on the board at +133.0, where pinning should stall the first attempt. Below $4,300 the thesis inverts: negative GEX nodes at $4,300 (−36.3) and $4,250 (−23.9) reactivate with no put support until $4,000, opening an air pocket.
